compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Update project documentation to reflect the changes shipped by this epic, including a CLAUDE.md rule 24 audit against the final implementation behavior.

**Why**: Documentation hygiene; ensures future agents have accurate awareness of the new ci-pr-mode workflow and dual-marker safety semantics.

**Scope**:
- IN: Audit CLAUDE.md rule 24 against the final S2 implementation (dual-marker AND-escape semantics, `.debug-active` marker, `DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0`); update any debug-everything skill quick-reference docs; update KNOWN-ISSUES.md if patterns emerged during implementation; follow `.claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md` formatting conventions.
- OUT: Creating new documentation files (update existing only); /sprint or other skill docs.

## Done Definitions

- When complete, CLAUDE.md rule 24 reflects the final S2 implementation behavior — explicit dual-marker AND-escape semantics, `.debug-active` marker reference, `DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0` escape hatch
  ← Satisfies: "CLAUDE.md rule 24 updated"
- When complete, debug-everything skill quick-reference docs reflect ci-pr-mode operation and sub-branch architecture
  ← Satisfies: "Documentation hygiene"
- When complete, KNOWN-ISSUES.md entries are added for any patterns surfaced during implementation that future agents should be aware of
  ← Satisfies: "Documentation hygiene"

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] CLAUDE.md rule 24 audit is the load-bearing piece — a stale rule 24 risks safeguard discipline drift

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
